hero.about: Alan Tudyk's crash-landed alien posing as a small-town Colorado doctor — final 10-episode arc, dropping all at once on Netflix Saturday. The show pivots fluidly between quirky comedy, murder mystery, and creature-feature without losing the dry humor that drives it. Originally aired on USA Network; Netflix gets all 4 seasons. S4 currently holds 100% RT (5 critic reviews — small sample but unanimous, with Screen Rant and Collider both calling it the show's strongest closer).
hero.why: Tonight/Saturday's marquee. Direct hit on four of your 'what lands' signals: dark humor + sci-fi combo, off-beat/quirky/sarcastic humor, ensemble cast, light(ish) tone with substance underneath. Alan Tudyk's deadpan alien is the kind of dry comedy you rated Murderbot S1 4⭐ and Solar Opposites 4-5⭐ for. Final season = closure, no cliffhanger trap. If you haven't seen S1-S3, Netflix has them — they're more episodic than serial so jumping in cold is easier than Vox Machina's lore-heavy backlog. Rate 1-5⭐ + 2-3 tags after the binge.
